policy_scoring_rules.<name>: raw mean log probability per residue -- the declared selection quantity
policy_scoring_rules.<name>_minus_parent: policy minus its own initial-SFT parent: DPO's implicit reward, the quantity the objective optimized. Beta is omitted because a positive scale cannot change a ranking.
